description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to declare that the Cess be charged, levied and paid on import of Waters, including mineral waters and aerated waters, etc. w.e.f. 29.06.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains an order issued under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979, which establishes a legal/regulatory framework for charging, levying, and paying cess on imported articles. It creates regulatory compliance requirements for importers and specifies detailed tariff codes and rates, making it primarily about legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structure.
